commands.help: Retrieves advanced security audit policies from local Group Policy
commands.long_help: Reads and combines audit.csv files from the local Group Policy directory to display configured advanced audit policies. Shows audit subcategory settings including inclusion/exclusion criteria and success/failure auditing configuration. When running a 32-bit implant on a 64-bit host (WoW64), set is_wow64 to 1 so the BOF reads from the sysnative GroupPolicy path instead of the redirected system32 path.

arguments.name: is-wow64
arguments.desc: Set to 1 if the implant is a 32-bit process on a 64-bit host (WoW64). Uses sysnative path to access the real GroupPolicy directory. Default: 0 (native process).
